Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).
A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.
Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.
Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.
What We Offer
Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.
Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.
Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.
A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.

Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:
Your experience with Go in production.
The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.
Your country of residence and preferred start date. You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager em jundiaí (RN)
description:
About Nature Co
Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.
Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.
Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.
Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.
Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.
Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia
Submission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. title: Senior backend engineer (golang) em montes claros (RN)
description:
OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA
Title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations
Company: Fulcrum Saa S
Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required)
Type: Full-time
Level:  Senior / Staff
Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location
About Fulcrum Saa S
Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.
Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.
The Role
We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.
You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.
You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.
What You’ll Do
Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.
Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.
Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.
Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.
Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.
Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.
Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.
What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)
5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).
Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.
Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.
Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.
Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.
Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.
Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.
Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.
Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.
Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).
Strong Nice-to-Haves
Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).
A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.
Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.
Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.
What We Offer
Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.
Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.
Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.
A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.
How to Apply
Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:
Your experience with Go in production.
The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.
Your country of residence and preferred start date. You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

title: Graphic designer em cuiabá (SE)
description:
Graphic Designer
Our Client is hiring a designer to support a high-output marketing team. This is not a brand-from-scratch role. The design system exists, and the job is to execute consistently, extend it intelligently, and keep things moving without hand-holding.
You’ll work directly with Marketing, with guidance from the Creative Director. Most of what you produce will show up in demand gen campaigns, event programs, and product marketing. It needs to look sharp, ship fast, and hold up across channels.
What you’ll do
You’ll be responsible for a wide range of design work tied directly to pipeline-driving campaigns
Create graphics for social, paid campaigns, email, and web
Design and iterate on landing pages in Webflow
Produce visual assets for webinars, virtual events, and campaigns
Design print collateral and occasional physical assets (including SWAG)
Create GIFs, motion elements, and lightweight animations
Edit video for social distribution and website use
Support ongoing campaign launches with fast-turn creative
This is a volume role, and you’ll be expected to make good decisions quickly and maintain quality under pace.
What matters in this role
You can operate inside an existing brand system without needing constant direction
You understand how design actually shows up in B2 B marketing, not just how it looks in a portfolio
You’re comfortable moving between formats. Static, motion, web, video. No one is handing off perfect briefs every time
You have strong judgment about what’s “good enough to ship” vs what needs refinement
You can manage your own workflow and keep projects moving without bottlenecks
Requirements
4+ years in a design role, ideally supporting marketing or growth teams
Strong portfolio that shows real campaign work, not just one-off visuals
Experience designing in Webflow (not just Figma concepts)
Experience with motion design and basic animation (GIFs, short-form video)
Video editing experience for social and web content
Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite
Context for the work
Our client sells to B2 B marketing teams running webinars and virtual events as part of pipeline generation. That means the creative you produce will be tied directly to:
Driving registrations and product demos
Increasing engagement
Supporting sales follow-up
Reinforcing brand credibility with senior marketing leaders The output needs to feel polished, but it has to perform, not just look good.
What this is not
Not a pure brand exploration role
Not a pixel-perfect, weeks-per-project environment
Not isolated design work handed over a wall
You’ll be in the middle of campaigns, working closely with marketers who are moving fast and expect the same from you.
If that sounds like your kind of environment, this will be a good fit.

title: Consultor de vendas em maranhão (MA)
description:
A Knauf é sinônimo de oportunidade. Sabemos que a oportunidade é diferente para cada pessoa e temos orgulho de ver possibilidades em todos. Esta posição na Knauf Brasil pode ser perfeita para você desenvolver uma carreira única em uma cultura baseada em valores, com o objetivo de fazer do amanhã um lar para todos nós. ♀️ ♂️
Somos um fabricante global de materiais de construção e nossos 41.500 membros presentes em 90 países e em 300 locais diferentes oferecem uma grande oportunidade para qualquer pessoa com ambição e energia. Valorizamos a contribuição de todos e pedimos que tragam todo o seu potencial para o trabalho, para enriquecer ainda mais o negócio, pois juntos alcançamos mais em um ambiente seguro e inclusivo.
A expansão do nosso time significa que agora estamos procurando uma pessoa para ocupar a função de CONSULTOR COMERCIAL para o MANAUS, AM reportando-se a COORDENAÇÃ O COMERCIAL.

✅ Você sempre pensa no cliente?
✅ Você age pensando nas gerações futuras?
✅ Você tem um histórico comprovado de resultados?
Se sim, gostaríamos de ouvir sua opinião. Nesta posição, você irá realizar o atendimento ao cliente, acompanhar pedidos e orçamentos, cumprir os prazos estabelecidos e as tratativas das ocorrências. Desenvolver e prospectar novos clientes. Ministrar treinamentos relacionados a produtos bem como implementar as decisões táticas e estratégicas da área comercial.
O que você fará?
️ Estudar e aplicar os conhecimentos relacionados a normas e produtos para que possa analisar e especificar produtos em clientes;
️Aplicar e gerenciar as informações relacionadas aos clientes através do One CRM e gerenciar o fluxo do pedido;
️Promover, desenvolver e efetivar vendas em distribuidores do segmento e construtoras, bem como realizar visitas a obras;
️Promover, desenvolver e efetivar vendas para instaladores do segmento, bem como realizar treinamentos de capacitação desses profissionais;
️Elaborar de relatórios comerciais e técnicos de visitas em clientes;

️Implementar a estratégia de Marketing e Trade Marketing;
️Garantir o fechamento de negócios desenvolvidos via especificação;
️Realizar a gestão comercial de multicanais e promoção de produtos.

Estamos interessados em você como pessoa; sua atitude, comportamentos e valores. Contanto que você tenha a disposição de aprender qualquer coisa que precise para a função que você ainda não tenha, adoraríamos falar com você. CNH habilitada e disponibilidade para viajar (50% do tempo)

Experiência com SAP e One CRM
Experiência no ramo de construção a seco

Vale Refeição + Vale Alimentação
Assistência Médica e Odontológica Bradesco
Carro frota + Auxílio Combustível
PLR + Incentivo de Vendas

Analisaremos sua candidatura e seu perfil sendo aprovado pela Área de Pessoas e Gestão da área, te convidaremos para um bate papo.

Compensation: R$350 – R$450 per week (based on tier) + bonuses (based on views)
Probation period: 2 weeks, paid R$250 / week
About Pure
Pure is a bold, global dating app redefining how people connect. We believe dating should be honest, fun, and free of judgment, a space to explore confidence, chemistry, and self-expression.
We’re building a UGC Creator Community of voices to help tell that story.
About the UGC Creator Community 
We’re looking for social media creators to join our UGC Pure Dating App Creator Community - a group of UGC content creators producing short-form videos (Tik Tok / Instagram) around themes like dating, confidence, self-love, etc.
As a creator, you’ll have the chance to collaborate with our team, build your personal brand, and get paid to create authentic, engaging content that challenges the way people see dating.
What You’ll Do
Create and post 7 short-form videos per week (Tik Tok / Instagram Reels / You Tube Shorts, etc)
Develop content inspired by dating, connection, and self-expression
Drive people to the app 
Participate in creative briefs, trend challenges, and campaigns
Receive feedback and coaching to grow your performance
Collaborate with our team on storytelling ideas and social strategies
What We’re Looking For
You must be based in Brazil and be fluent in Portuguese 
Passion for storytelling, social media, and modern culture
Familiarity with Tik Tok trends, Reels formats, and UGC-style videos
Strong on-camera presence and editing skills
Consistency and ability to meet weekly content goals

Payment Structure
Tiered structure paid weekly
Bonuses for views (starting from 100 K+ views)
Bonuses for registrations

Why Join Us
Get paid to create authentic content about dating & self-expression
Access creative guidance, briefs, and a global network of creators
Build your portfolio while collaborating 
Enjoy creative freedom - your tone, your story, your perspective

Send us your cover letter and tell us a bit about yourself, including why you’d like to work with Pure app.

Estamos procurando criadores de conteúdo para redes sociais para se juntarem à nossa Comunidade de Criadores UGC do Pure — um grupo que produz vídeos curtos (Tik Tok / Instagram) sobre temas como namoro, confiança, amor-próprio, entre outros.

O que você vai fazer
Criar e postar 7 vídeos curtos por semana (Tik Tok / Instagram Reels / You Tube Shorts, etc.)
Desenvolver conteúdos inspirados em namoro, conexões e autoexpressão
Direcionar pessoas para o app
Participar de briefings criativos, tendências e campanhas
Receber feedback e orientação para melhorar sua performance
Colaborar com o time em ideias de storytelling e estratégias sociais O que buscamos
Você deve estar baseado no Brasil e ser fluente em português
Paixão por storytelling, redes sociais e cultura contemporânea
Familiaridade com tendências do Tik Tok, formatos de Reels e conteúdo UGC
Boa presença em frente às câmeras e habilidades de edição
Consistência e capacidade de cumprir metas semanais de conteúdo
Mente aberta e conforto para criar conteúdos sobre namoro e relacionamentos Estrutura de pagamento
Estrutura por níveis com pagamento semanal
Bônus por visualizações (a partir de 100 mil views)
Bônus por registros
Pagamentos realizados semanalmente Por que se juntar a nós
Seja pago para criar conteúdo autêntico sobre namoro e autoexpressão
Acesso a orientação criativa, briefings e uma rede global de criadores
Construa seu portfólio enquanto colabora com a gente
Liberdade criativa — seu estilo, sua história, sua perspectiva Como se candidatar Envie sua carta de apresentação e conte um pouco sobre você, incluindo por que gostaria de trabalhar com o app Pure.

title: Consultor de vendas i em são paulo (RN)
description:
Descrição da vaga
Nós somos a CVC Corp, o maior grupo de viagens das Américas, formado por unidades de negócios que atuam com marcas distintas nos segmentos de viagens de férias e de lazer, viagens corporativas e relacionadas a cursos e intercâmbio cultural no exterior. A evolução, a expertise e o pioneirismo das nossas marcas impactam o mercado e a economia, com o proposito de embarcar com você pelo mundo, proporcionando as melhores experiências todos os dias .
Aqui, formamos um time que busca evolução constante, protagonismo e bons motivos para continuar transformando o mundo com o nosso negócio.
A nossa bandeira é o respeito. E para fortalecer a nossa diversidade, queremos expandir a pluralidade da nossa gente buscando equidade e valorizando diferentes perspectivas, pautadas nos pilares de Gênero, LGBTI+, Raça, Pessoas com Deficiência e 50+ tornando o nosso ambiente mais diverso e representativo
Venha com a gente fazer parte desta transformação!
#cvccorpcomvc

Responsabilidades e atribuições
Atendimento e Consultoria: Pesquisar, orientar e assistir clientes na escolha de destinos, traduzindo necessidades em roteiros personalizados. title: Advogado trabalhista em são paulo (RN)
description:
Segue a versão em texto único , mais fluida e pronta para colar no campo de descrição do :
Estamos em busca de um profissional para integrar a área comercial do escritório Iully Freire Advocacia , com atuação presencial em Ribeirão Preto/SP. A posição é voltada para pessoas com perfil comunicativo, organizado e orientado a resultados, que tenham interesse em atuar no atendimento e condução de potenciais clientes na área trabalhista, especialmente no relacionamento inicial, qualificação de demandas e direcionamento estratégico dentro do fluxo comercial do escritório.
O profissional será responsável por realizar o primeiro contato com leads oriundos de canais digitais, conduzir atendimentos com escuta ativa e empatia, identificar oportunidades jurídicas a partir das informações coletadas e organizar essas informações em sistemas internos, garantindo clareza e continuidade no atendimento. Buscamos alguém com boa comunicação verbal e escrita, facilidade no uso de ferramentas digitais, capacidade de organização e disciplina para trabalhar com processos estruturados. É importante ter proatividade, senso de responsabilidade e habilidade para lidar com pessoas em momentos sensíveis, já que grande parte dos atendimentos envolve questões trabalhistas. Um perfil atento a detalhes, com capacidade de aprendizado rápido e interesse em evoluir dentro de uma área comercial jurídica, fará diferença no desempenho da função.
Experiência prévia em atendimento, vendas ou rotinas comerciais é um diferencial, assim como familiaridade com sistemas de CRM e vivência, ainda que básica, no ambiente jurídico. No entanto, mais do que experiência, valorizamos pessoas com postura profissional, comprometimento e vontade de crescer junto com o escritório.
A oportunidade é ideal para quem deseja se desenvolver em uma área comercial estruturada dentro do setor jurídico, participando ativamente da organização dos processos de captação e relacionamento com clientes, com espaço para aprendizado, evolução e contribuição direta nos resultados do escritório.

title: Marketing ai agent builder em cotia (MA)
description:
Role Overview:
As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.
Core Responsibilities:
• Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.
• Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.
• Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.
• Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.
• System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including Hub Spot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.
Qualifications & Skills:
• Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market Saa S revenue engine.
• AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude Co Work, Code X)
• Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI).
• Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.
• Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.
• Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2 B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: Product designer lead (ux/ui) em rio verde (CE)
description: Professional English is a requirement for this role A challenge will be required for evaluation About Foundey Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage Saa S startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products. The Opportunity We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments. The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2 B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and Saa S sectors. title: Gtm builder em serra (PI)
description:
GTM builder
You are an AI-native builder. You don’t just use AI tools; you build agents, copilots, and autonomous systems. You understand how modern LLMs actually work: tool use, reasoning loops, structured outputs, retrieval, memory, and orchestration. You are comfortable vibe-coding, shipping fast, and learning new AI tooling weekly. You’ve built side projects, internal tools, or production systems using LLMs, agents, or automation frameworks. You think in systems, not scripts. You’ll be responsible for building A...
You know that the leverage of a single great AI builder today is 10–100x a traditional engineer. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.
You Will:
• Design and deploy autonomous AI agents that can research, reason, and execute real business workflows
• Build agentic systems using modern LLM capabilities including tool use, function calling, structured outputs, and multi-step reasoning
• Create internal AI copilots used daily by marketing, sales and operations
• Implement retrieval systems (RAG) using embeddings and vector databases to give agents context and memory
• Build AI workflows that can enrich accounts, qualify leads, generate insights, and automate execution
• Integrate AI agents deeply into our stack: Hub Spot, internal databases, enrichment platforms, and product systems
• Automate workflows that previously required human operational effort
• Build scraping, parsing, and AI extraction systems to convert unstructured web data into structured intelligence
• Rapidly prototype, test, and deploy new AI capabilities as new models and tools become available
• Continuously improve agents to make them faster, smarter, cheaper, and more reliable
• Build reusable internal frameworks, tools, and agent architectures
• Own systems end-to-end — from idea to production
You Have:
• Strong software engineering ability and the ability to ship working systems quickly
• Hands-on experience building with modern LLMs and AI tools (Open AI, Anthropic, open models, or similar)
• Experience building AI agents, copilots, or automated workflows
• Strong prompt engineering skills and understanding of structured prompting and reliability
• Experience integrating APIs, webhooks, and external systems
• Ability to work with structured and unstructured data
• Experience with automation tools like N8 N, Make, Zapier, or similar
• Comfort working with web scraping, enrichment systems, and data pipelines
• Strong builder mindset — you learn fast, experiment fast, and ship fast
• High agency — you figure things out without needing step-by-step instructions
• Curiosity and obsession with new AI capabilities
• Bonus: Experience with vector databases, embeddings, or retrieval systems
• Bonus: Experience building multi-step agent workflows

• Bonus: You use AI coding tools as part of your daily workflow

title: Lifecycle & retention strategist (klaviyo) em olinda (RN)
description:
ABOUT ATTN AGENCY
ATTN Agency (pronounced Attention Agency) is a boutique, performance-driven digital marketing agency trusted by e-commerce and DTC brands looking to scale profitably. We specialize in full-funnel growth across Google, Meta, Tik Tok, Klaviyo, Postscript, and emerging platforms — with a laser focus on ROAS, new customer acquisition, and incremental revenue.
We don't just manage emails. We build scalable systems for sustainable growth and we're selective about who we work with and who we hire. If you're obsessed with performance, welcome home.
ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a Senior Lifecycle and Retention Strategist to own and drive retention strategy across a portfolio of high-growth e Commerce and DTC brands. This is a senior, client-facing role that sits at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and execution oversight.
You will be responsible for building and managing full lifecycle programs spanning email, SMS, direct mail, and loyalty, while leading the strategic direction for each brand on your portfolio. You think in customer journeys, speak fluently in data, and know how to translate insights into programs that move revenue.
You will also play a key role in evaluating and recommending the right tech stack for each client, including loyalty platforms, subscription tools, review integrations, and emerging retention channels, ensuring every brand is set up with the right infrastructure to scale.
This is not a coordinator role. We need someone who has been here before, can lead without being managed, and is ready to take ownership of outcomes.
SCOPE OF WORK
Strategy and Campaign Planning
Own the lifecycle roadmap across email, SMS, direct mail, and loyalty for a portfolio of 5 to 7 high-growth e Commerce brands
Develop rolling 30-day campaign calendars aligned with product launches, promotions, and paid media activity
Write clear, detailed copy briefs and flow outlines tailored to each brand's voice, tone, and audience
Build segmentation frameworks and customer journey maps designed to maximize engagement and lifetime value
Leverage AI tools and advanced analytics to uncover opportunities and improve workflow efficiency
Delegate campaign and flow builds to Retention Coordinators, then review, QA, and deliver actionable feedback
Coordinate with design and copy teams to keep assets and Click Up timelines on track
Mentor junior team members and actively contribute to growing their strategic and technical capabilities Optimization and Performance
Analyze performance across deliverability, engagement, conversion rate, revenue per recipient, and cohort LTV
Design and execute A/B and multivariate tests across creative, cadence, offers, and segments and translate results into clear next steps
Refine benchmarks, identify trends, and get ahead of problems before they affect performance
Evaluate and pilot emerging retention channels including loyalty tiers, push notifications, and in-app messaging
Document learnings and contribute to internal best practice development and team training Tech Stack Management and Recommendations
Audit existing client tech stacks, identify gaps, and recommend the right tools for each brand's stage of growth
Advise on and help implement solutions across loyalty and rewards (Yotpo, Smile.io, Loyalty Lion), subscription management (Recharge, Skio, Stay), review and UGC platforms (Okendo, Stamped, Junip), SMS (Postscript, Attentive, Klaviyo SMS), post-purchase tools (Wonderment, Malomo, After Ship), push notifications, and direct mail (Post Pilot, Paper Run, etc.)
Stay current on the retention technology landscape and bring proactive recommendations to clients and the internal team Client Collaboration
Join monthly or bi-weekly client calls led by Account Managers to present strategy, performance insights, and testing roadmaps
Deliver concise, data-driven performance summaries that clearly communicate wins, gaps, and next steps
Partner with Account Managers to ensure retention strategy integrates seamlessly with each client's broader growth initiatives
REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
4+ years of lifecycle and retention marketing experience, the majority within e Commerce or DTC
Proven track record managing email and SMS programs that have directly contributed to measurable revenue growth
Deep knowledge of Klaviyo including flows, segmentation, deliverability, and performance analysis
Experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously, preferably in an agency environment
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, spot trends, and build a clear strategic response
Solid understanding of the e Commerce retention tech ecosystem with the ability to make confident platform recommendations
Experience briefing and managing creative and copy teams
Excellent written and verbal communication skills including the ability to present strategy clearly to clients
Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced remote environment
Proficiency with Click Up (Or similar project management platform), Slack, and GSuite
NICE TO HAVE
Experience with SMS platforms such as Postscript or Attentive
Hands-on experience implementing or managing loyalty and subscription tools
Familiarity with direct mail as a retention channel
Experience mentoring or managing junior team members
Experience with other ESPs like Braze, Iterable, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud
HOW WE WORK
You will work directly with our Director of Lifecycle and Retention Marketing and collaborate closely with Account Managers, additional Retention Strategists, designers, and copywriters. We operate through Click Up for project management and Slack for day-to-day communication. Availability and responsiveness between 9am and 5pm US hours on business days is required.

title: Gerente de projeto de design em petrolina (PE)
description:
Sobre a vaga
A Bas-Alto é um estúdio de design full-service que opera sob o modelo de fractional design team: o fundador atua como design lead embedded em empresas parceiras, integrado aos times e às decisões de produto e de marca. A Bas-Alto é a estrutura que sustenta essa atuação: um time de designers entregando produto, web e visual design em paralelo, com o Gerente de Projetos/Design Ops garantindo que tudo opere com consistência enquanto o fundador está focado na frente estratégica. Estamos contratando um(a) Gerente de Projetos de Design para trabalhar como \" braço direito operacional \" do fundador do estúdio na gestão de projetos de design. O papel central é garantir que o time de designers tenha sempre briefings claros, prioridades bem definidas e entregas organizadas, mantendo múltiplos projetos simultâneos rodando com qualidade e sem perder prazo.
Responsabilidades
Relacionamento com os clientes no dia a dia , respondendo a dúvidas, alinhando expectativas e garantindo que estejam sempre informados sobre o andamento dos projetos (por escrito, em inglês). Suporte direto ao design lead na condução dos projetos e organização de demandas Criação de briefings executáveis que traduzem as necessidades e objetivos em projetos para a equipe de design Gerenciar tarefas , entregas e prazos em plataformas como Click Up, Asana, Notion ou similares Acompanhar o andamento de entregas de design (produto, web e marketing), garantindo qualidade e consistência
Fazer o handoff das entregas finais para os clientes, garantindo clareza, organização e um padrão elevado de apresentação
Estruturar fluxos de trabalho, cronogramas e processos internos
Antecipar gargalos, resolver impedimentos e manter os projetos em movimento Diferencial: D ireção de design dos projetos (para candidatos com background sólido em design)
Necessário
Experiência sólida em gestão de projetos , de preferência em estúdios de design, agências ou startups Experiência sólida no setor de tecnologia e de gestão de produtos digitais Familiaridade com Figma e com o universo de design: entender o que são um wireframe, um design system, uma entrega de UI ou um fluxo de UX. Inglês fluente em escrita e leitura. Extrema organização e atenção a detalhe para manejar múltiplas frentes ao mesmo tempo Comunicação clara e objetiva, tanto com clientes quanto com a equipe
Domínio de ferramentas de gestão de projetos (Click Up, Asana, Notion, Jira ou similares)
Experiência com um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico/ágil de startups
Remuneração e modelo
Salário a partir de R$ 3.600+, podendo ser significativamente maior para candidatos com background sólido em design (que consigam atuar também na direção de design dos projetos).
Contratação: CLT ou PJ, a negociar
Formato de trabalho: 100% remoto
Horário flexível. Obs.: É necessária disponibilidade para atender demandas também no período noturno, devido ao fuso horário dos clientes da Califórnia (4h antes do horário do Brasil).

title: Senior voip engineer em eusébio (CE)
description:
About the role
We are hiring a Senior Vo IP Engineer to help shape and evolve a large-scale real-time communications platform, including the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.
This role sits at the intersection of telecom, networking, and software engineering , and requires practical, production-grade experience across all three. You will contribute directly to architectural decisions, build new services, and improve voice systems that customers rely on every day.
This is a developer role — not an integrator or operator position. We are looking for someone who has written code that routes, manipulates, and reasons about SIP traffic at scale.
What you'll do
Design and develop services for a production-grade real-time communications platform.
Build and maintain telephony applications using open-source and commercial platforms.
Contribute to and help lead the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.
Design and implement call routing logic, SIP signaling flows, and media handling.
Troubleshoot complex issues in live voice environments — signaling, media, performance, and reliability.
Partner closely with operations and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure service stability and scalability. What we're looking for:
Required 5+ years as a developer building Vo IP / SIP systems — not solely operating or integrating commercial platforms.
Hands-on production experience with both layers of an open-source SIP stack: A B2 BUA / media server: Asterisk or Free SWITCH
A SIP proxy / routing layer: Kamailio or Open SIPS
Proven track record building and operating voice platforms in production.
Solid understanding of SIP signaling, dialog state, NAT traversal, and real-time media behavior.
Comfort reading and writing code, not only configuration.
Advanced English proficiency (written and spoken). Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong plus Python for automation, tooling, or service development. SQL and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
Event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Kafka, Rabbit MQ, NATS).
Dev Ops and automation tooling (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines).
Exposure to RTPengine, Homer SIP capture, Web RTC gateways, or SBCs.
Experience contributing to or maintaining infrastructure-as-code.
Why this role
Fully remote with a flexible working model.
Direct ownership of architectural decisions on a platform handling real production traffic.
High-impact migration project — your work shapes the next generation of the platform.
Tight, technical team where engineering quality is a first-class concern.
Continuous learning culture with support for training and development.

Salário a partir de R$ 3.600+, podendo ser significativamente maior para candidatos com background sólido em design (que consigam atuar também na direção de design dos projetos).

title: Senior voip engineer em campinas (CE)
description:
About the role
We are hiring a Senior Vo IP Engineer to help shape and evolve a large-scale real-time communications platform, including the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.
This role sits at the intersection of telecom, networking, and software engineering , and requires practical, production-grade experience across all three. You will contribute directly to architectural decisions, build new services, and improve voice systems that customers rely on every day.
This is a developer role — not an integrator or operator position. We are looking for someone who has written code that routes, manipulates, and reasons about SIP traffic at scale.
What you'll do
Design and develop services for a production-grade real-time communications platform.
Build and maintain telephony applications using open-source and commercial platforms.
Contribute to and help lead the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.
Design and implement call routing logic, SIP signaling flows, and media handling.
Troubleshoot complex issues in live voice environments — signaling, media, performance, and reliability.
Partner closely with operations and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure service stability and scalability. What we're looking for:
Required 5+ years as a developer building Vo IP / SIP systems — not solely operating or integrating commercial platforms.
Hands-on production experience with both layers of an open-source SIP stack: A B2 BUA / media server: Asterisk or Free SWITCH
A SIP proxy / routing layer: Kamailio or Open SIPS
Proven track record building and operating voice platforms in production.
Solid understanding of SIP signaling, dialog state, NAT traversal, and real-time media behavior.
Comfort reading and writing code, not only configuration.
Advanced English proficiency (written and spoken). Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong plus Python for automation, tooling, or service development. SQL and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
Event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Kafka, Rabbit MQ, NATS).
Dev Ops and automation tooling (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines).
Exposure to RTPengine, Homer SIP capture, Web RTC gateways, or SBCs.
Experience contributing to or maintaining infrastructure-as-code.
Why this role
Fully remote with a flexible working model.
Direct ownership of architectural decisions on a platform handling real production traffic.
High-impact migration project — your work shapes the next generation of the platform.
Tight, technical team where engineering quality is a first-class concern.
Continuous learning culture with support for training and development.

title: Lifecycle & retention strategist (klaviyo) em eusébio (CE)
description:
ABOUT ATTN AGENCY
ATTN Agency (pronounced Attention Agency) is a boutique, performance-driven digital marketing agency trusted by e-commerce and DTC brands looking to scale profitably. We specialize in full-funnel growth across Google, Meta, Tik Tok, Klaviyo, Postscript, and emerging platforms — with a laser focus on ROAS, new customer acquisition, and incremental revenue.
We don't just manage emails. We build scalable systems for sustainable growth and we're selective about who we work with and who we hire. If you're obsessed with performance, welcome home.
ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a Senior Lifecycle and Retention Strategist to own and drive retention strategy across a portfolio of high-growth e Commerce and DTC brands. This is a senior, client-facing role that sits at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and execution oversight.
You will be responsible for building and managing full lifecycle programs spanning email, SMS, direct mail, and loyalty, while leading the strategic direction for each brand on your portfolio. You think in customer journeys, speak fluently in data, and know how to translate insights into programs that move revenue.
You will also play a key role in evaluating and recommending the right tech stack for each client, including loyalty platforms, subscription tools, review integrations, and emerging retention channels, ensuring every brand is set up with the right infrastructure to scale.
This is not a coordinator role. We need someone who has been here before, can lead without being managed, and is ready to take ownership of outcomes.
SCOPE OF WORK
Strategy and Campaign Planning
Own the lifecycle roadmap across email, SMS, direct mail, and loyalty for a portfolio of 5 to 7 high-growth e Commerce brands
Develop rolling 30-day campaign calendars aligned with product launches, promotions, and paid media activity
Write clear, detailed copy briefs and flow outlines tailored to each brand's voice, tone, and audience
Build segmentation frameworks and customer journey maps designed to maximize engagement and lifetime value
Leverage AI tools and advanced analytics to uncover opportunities and improve workflow efficiency
Delegate campaign and flow builds to Retention Coordinators, then review, QA, and deliver actionable feedback
Coordinate with design and copy teams to keep assets and Click Up timelines on track
Mentor junior team members and actively contribute to growing their strategic and technical capabilities Optimization and Performance
Analyze performance across deliverability, engagement, conversion rate, revenue per recipient, and cohort LTV
Design and execute A/B and multivariate tests across creative, cadence, offers, and segments and translate results into clear next steps
Refine benchmarks, identify trends, and get ahead of problems before they affect performance
Evaluate and pilot emerging retention channels including loyalty tiers, push notifications, and in-app messaging
Document learnings and contribute to internal best practice development and team training Tech Stack Management and Recommendations
Audit existing client tech stacks, identify gaps, and recommend the right tools for each brand's stage of growth
Advise on and help implement solutions across loyalty and rewards (Yotpo, Smile.io, Loyalty Lion), subscription management (Recharge, Skio, Stay), review and UGC platforms (Okendo, Stamped, Junip), SMS (Postscript, Attentive, Klaviyo SMS), post-purchase tools (Wonderment, Malomo, After Ship), push notifications, and direct mail (Post Pilot, Paper Run, etc.)
Stay current on the retention technology landscape and bring proactive recommendations to clients and the internal team Client Collaboration
Join monthly or bi-weekly client calls led by Account Managers to present strategy, performance insights, and testing roadmaps
Deliver concise, data-driven performance summaries that clearly communicate wins, gaps, and next steps
Partner with Account Managers to ensure retention strategy integrates seamlessly with each client's broader growth initiatives
REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
4+ years of lifecycle and retention marketing experience, the majority within e Commerce or DTC
Proven track record managing email and SMS programs that have directly contributed to measurable revenue growth
Deep knowledge of Klaviyo including flows, segmentation, deliverability, and performance analysis
Experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously, preferably in an agency environment
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, spot trends, and build a clear strategic response
Solid understanding of the e Commerce retention tech ecosystem with the ability to make confident platform recommendations
Experience briefing and managing creative and copy teams
Excellent written and verbal communication skills including the ability to present strategy clearly to clients
Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced remote environment
Proficiency with Click Up (Or similar project management platform), Slack, and GSuite
NICE TO HAVE
Experience with SMS platforms such as Postscript or Attentive
Hands-on experience implementing or managing loyalty and subscription tools
Familiarity with direct mail as a retention channel
Experience mentoring or managing junior team members
Experience with other ESPs like Braze, Iterable, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud
HOW WE WORK
You will work directly with our Director of Lifecycle and Retention Marketing and collaborate closely with Account Managers, additional Retention Strategists, designers, and copywriters. We operate through Click Up for project management and Slack for day-to-day communication. Availability and responsiveness between 9am and 5pm US hours on business days is required.

title: Senior voip engineer em cascavel (PI)
description:
About the role
We are hiring a Senior Vo IP Engineer to help shape and evolve a large-scale real-time communications platform, including the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.
This role sits at the intersection of telecom, networking, and software engineering , and requires practical, production-grade experience across all three. You will contribute directly to architectural decisions, build new services, and improve voice systems that customers rely on every day.
This is a developer role — not an integrator or operator position. We are looking for someone who has written code that routes, manipulates, and reasons about SIP traffic at scale.
What you'll do
Design and develop services for a production-grade real-time communications platform.
Build and maintain telephony applications using open-source and commercial platforms.
Contribute to and help lead the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.
Design and implement call routing logic, SIP signaling flows, and media handling.
Troubleshoot complex issues in live voice environments — signaling, media, performance, and reliability.
Partner closely with operations and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure service stability and scalability. What we're looking for:
Required 5+ years as a developer building Vo IP / SIP systems — not solely operating or integrating commercial platforms.
Hands-on production experience with both layers of an open-source SIP stack: A B2 BUA / media server: Asterisk or Free SWITCH
A SIP proxy / routing layer: Kamailio or Open SIPS
Proven track record building and operating voice platforms in production.
Solid understanding of SIP signaling, dialog state, NAT traversal, and real-time media behavior.
Comfort reading and writing code, not only configuration.
Advanced English proficiency (written and spoken). Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong plus Python for automation, tooling, or service development. SQL and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
Event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Kafka, Rabbit MQ, NATS).
Dev Ops and automation tooling (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines).
Exposure to RTPengine, Homer SIP capture, Web RTC gateways, or SBCs.
Experience contributing to or maintaining infrastructure-as-code.
Why this role
Fully remote with a flexible working model.
Direct ownership of architectural decisions on a platform handling real production traffic.
High-impact migration project — your work shapes the next generation of the platform.
Tight, technical team where engineering quality is a first-class concern.
Continuous learning culture with support for training and development.

title: Consultor funcional sap pm — pleno | remoto | pj em eusébio (CE)
description:
A Acção é uma consultoria SAP especializada em implementação e desenvolvimento de soluções para gestão de frotas e manutenção. Somos parceiros SAP e temos produto próprio disponível no SAP Store — o Acção Fleet Management — em expansão ativa com clientes nos setores de logística, agronegócio e manufatura.

Num primeiro momento, você atuará em conjunto com o técnico nos projetos em andamento, absorvendo o produto, os processos e a metodologia de entrega. Com o tempo, você assumirá autonomamente o ciclo funcional completo das implementações.

Configuração do módulo SAP PM (ordens, planos de manutenção, equipamentos, medições)
Suporte à integração com MM e FI quando necessário
Elaboração e manutenção de documentação funcional
Treinamento de key users e suporte pós go-live
Participação ativa na evolução do produto Acção Fleet Management
O que buscamos:
Experiência sólida em SAP PM — pelo menos 2 implementações completas como consultor funcional
Capacidade de conduzir levantamento de requisitos e interagir com cliente de forma autônoma
Experiência em projetos compartilhados com outras consultorias
Perfil consultivo, comunicativo e orientado a entrega
Familiaridade com SAP Fiori como usuário (não é necessário desenvolvimento)
Disponibilidade para viagens a clientes (~20% do tempo)
Diferenciais valorizados:
Conhecimento em MM ou FI básico
Experiência com produtos SAP verticalizados ou soluções de frota
Vontade real de crescer em uma empresa de produto, não apenas de serviço
O que oferecemos:
Modelo PJ, predominantemente remoto com viagens pontuais a clientes (~20% do tempo)
Projetos desafiadores em clientes de médio e grande porte
Contato direto com o equipe técnica — aprendizado real, sem burocracia
Crescimento acelerado: a meta é você liderar as implementações de forma independente
Empresa com produto próprio no SAP Store — você ajuda a construir algo concreto
Interessado? Envie seu CV e Linked In para com o assunto: Consultor SAP PM — Acção

title: Ugc content creator em campo largo (PI)
description:
Location: Remote
Type: Freelance / Contract
Compensation: R$350 – R$450 per week (based on tier) + bonuses (based on views)
Probation period: 2 weeks, paid R$250 / week
About Pure
Pure is a bold, global dating app redefining how people connect. We believe dating should be honest, fun, and free of judgment, a space to explore confidence, chemistry, and self-expression.
We’re building a UGC Creator Community of voices to help tell that story.
About the UGC Creator Community 
We’re looking for social media creators to join our UGC Pure Dating App Creator Community - a group of UGC content creators producing short-form videos (Tik Tok / Instagram) around themes like dating, confidence, self-love, etc.
As a creator, you’ll have the chance to collaborate with our team, build your personal brand, and get paid to create authentic, engaging content that challenges the way people see dating.
What You’ll Do
Create and post 7 short-form videos per week (Tik Tok / Instagram Reels / You Tube Shorts, etc)
Develop content inspired by dating, connection, and self-expression
Drive people to the app 
Participate in creative briefs, trend challenges, and campaigns
Receive feedback and coaching to grow your performance
Collaborate with our team on storytelling ideas and social strategies
What We’re Looking For
You must be based in Brazil and be fluent in Portuguese 
Passion for storytelling, social media, and modern culture
Familiarity with Tik Tok trends, Reels formats, and UGC-style videos
Strong on-camera presence and editing skills
Consistency and ability to meet weekly content goals
Open-minded and comfortable creating content about dating and relationships
Payment Structure
Tiered structure paid weekly
Bonuses for views (starting from 100 K+ views)
Bonuses for registrations
Payments are made weekly
Why Join Us
Get paid to create authentic content about dating & self-expression
Access creative guidance, briefs, and a global network of creators
Build your portfolio while collaborating 
Enjoy creative freedom - your tone, your story, your perspective
How to Apply
Send us your cover letter and tell us a bit about yourself, including why you’d like to work with Pure app. 
You’ll be invited to join a group onboarding call and receive a task to create a test submission video. 
After that, you’ll enter a 2-week trial period, and if successful, you’ll be fully onboarded into the program.
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

● Familiar with all internal and external SOPs.
● Strives to find process efficiencies by thinking outside the box and making recommendations for change.
● Knowledge of ERP systems, Net Suite a plus
● Excellent client facing skills, including comfortability with all types of client communications.
● Prior speaker bureau experience a plus

The Sr. Business Analyst is responsible for managing financial and operational aspects of assigned clients and their products. This role requires a high level of understanding of the assigned clients and products, various speaker bureau project types, and the ability to work independently.
The Sr. Business Analyst works closely with the Director and financial analysts to ensure accurate internal and external financial reporting, develop budget proposals and provide financial related support in client meetings.
Financial
● Oversee day-to-day financial operations for speaker bureau, including budget tracking, internal revenue accruals, forecasting and variance analysis.
● Develops Statement of Work (SOW), ensuring final sign-off by Director as required.
● Create and manage budgets and proposals, providing oversight for complex SOWs. Prepare speaker bureau specific budgets, accrual reports and monthly financial management updates
● Work closely with program directors on monthly accrual reports, reviewing and discussing as needed.
● Ensure accuracy in financial reconciliation data before releasing reports to clients
● Generate and distribute monthly accruals and budget reports for clients
● Provide invoicing amounts to Accounts Receivable to facilitate timely invoice submissions
Operational
● Ensures compliance with internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and client specific SOPs.
● Provides budget related support in client meetings as needed.
● Participates in accrual meetings with clients based on their SOPs.
● Contributes to process improvement initiatives to enhance financial operations.
Experience and Skills
● 2+ Years experience in budgeting · Proficiency in Excel functions for financial modeling and analysis.
● Strong financial analysis skills, including budget tracking, forecasting and variance analysis · Excellent understanding of internal SOPs and ability to ensure compliance
● Familiar with all internal and external SOPs.
● Strives to find process efficiencies by thinking outside the box and making recommendations for change.
● Knowledge of ERP systems, Net Suite a plus
● Excellent client facing skills, including comfortability with all types of client communications.
● Prior speaker bureau experience a plus

title: Gtm builder em juazeiro do norte (CE)
description:
GTM builder
You are an AI-native builder. You don’t just use AI tools; you build agents, copilots, and autonomous systems. You understand how modern LLMs actually work: tool use, reasoning loops, structured outputs, retrieval, memory, and orchestration. You are comfortable vibe-coding, shipping fast, and learning new AI tooling weekly. You’ve built side projects, internal tools, or production systems using LLMs, agents, or automation frameworks. You think in systems, not scripts. You’ll be responsible for building A...
You know that the leverage of a single great AI builder today is 10–100x a traditional engineer. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.
You Will:
• Design and deploy autonomous AI agents that can research, reason, and execute real business workflows
• Build agentic systems using modern LLM capabilities including tool use, function calling, structured outputs, and multi-step reasoning
• Create internal AI copilots used daily by marketing, sales and operations
• Implement retrieval systems (RAG) using embeddings and vector databases to give agents context and memory
• Build AI workflows that can enrich accounts, qualify leads, generate insights, and automate execution
• Integrate AI agents deeply into our stack: Hub Spot, internal databases, enrichment platforms, and product systems
• Automate workflows that previously required human operational effort
• Build scraping, parsing, and AI extraction systems to convert unstructured web data into structured intelligence
• Rapidly prototype, test, and deploy new AI capabilities as new models and tools become available
• Continuously improve agents to make them faster, smarter, cheaper, and more reliable
• Build reusable internal frameworks, tools, and agent architectures
• Own systems end-to-end — from idea to production
You Have:
• Strong software engineering ability and the ability to ship working systems quickly
• Hands-on experience building with modern LLMs and AI tools (Open AI, Anthropic, open models, or similar)
• Experience building AI agents, copilots, or automated workflows
• Strong prompt engineering skills and understanding of structured prompting and reliability
• Experience integrating APIs, webhooks, and external systems
• Ability to work with structured and unstructured data
• Experience with automation tools like N8 N, Make, Zapier, or similar
• Comfort working with web scraping, enrichment systems, and data pipelines
• Strong builder mindset — you learn fast, experiment fast, and ship fast
• High agency — you figure things out without needing step-by-step instructions
• Curiosity and obsession with new AI capabilities
• Bonus: Experience with vector databases, embeddings, or retrieval systems
• Bonus: Experience building multi-step agent workflows
• Bonus: You actively build AI projects outside of work
• Bonus: You use AI coding tools as part of your daily workflow

description:
About the Role
We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Compliance Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team at Velafi. In this role, you will be instrumental in managing and enhancing the onboarding and KYC (Know Your Customer) processes for our clients across multiple jurisdictions, with a strong focus on Brazil and Latin America.
You will collaborate closely with Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to design efficient, scalable onboarding frameworks that deliver a seamless customer experience while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory requirements. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment and is passionate about balancing compliance excellence with business enablement.

Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of onboarding controls, policies, and procedures to ensure efficiency, scalability, and regulatory compliance.
Act as the subject matter expert for onboarding clients operating in Brazil, ensuring alignment with Brazilian local AML/CTF regulations and industry best practices.
Perform detailed reviews and analysis of B2 B customer documentation, including Customer Risk Assessments and Customer Due Diligence to support informed onboarding decisions.

Support the Compliance function in applying regulatory frameworks across LATAM jurisdictions, ensuring compliant operations in Brazil matters.

Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, with a strong foundation in Compliance.
3+ years of hands-on experience in Compliance, preferably within fintech, digital banking, payments, or financial services environments.
Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, CDD, and CRA frameworks
Solid understanding of Brazilian AML/CTF regulations
Familiarity with international regulatory standards, including BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, and OFAC
Ability to evaluate complex customer structures, identify risks, and make sound compliance decisions.
Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex regulatory concepts clearly.
Fluent in Spanish (English is a strong plus).
Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-growing environment with evolving regulatory landscapes.

title: Sr. compliance onboarding specialist em maracanaú (CE)
description:
About the Role
We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Compliance Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team at Velafi. In this role, you will be instrumental in managing and enhancing the onboarding and KYC (Know Your Customer) processes for our clients across multiple jurisdictions, with a strong focus on Brazil and Latin America.
You will collaborate closely with Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to design efficient, scalable onboarding frameworks that deliver a seamless customer experience while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory requirements. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment and is passionate about balancing compliance excellence with business enablement.
Key Responsibilities

Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of onboarding controls, policies, and procedures to ensure efficiency, scalability, and regulatory compliance.
Act as the subject matter expert for onboarding clients operating in Brazil, ensuring alignment with Brazilian local AML/CTF regulations and industry best practices.
Perform detailed reviews and analysis of B2 B customer documentation, including Customer Risk Assessments and Customer Due Diligence to support informed onboarding decisions.
Partner with Sales, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to provide clear guidance on compliance requirements, enabling smooth client onboarding and expansion into new markets. Advise internal teams on AML risks and regulatory considerations when entering new industries or geographic regions.

Support the Compliance function in applying regulatory frameworks across LATAM jurisdictions, ensuring compliant operations in Brazil matters.

Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, with a strong foundation in Compliance.
3+ years of hands-on experience in Compliance, preferably within fintech, digital banking, payments, or financial services environments.
Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, CDD, and CRA frameworks
Solid understanding of Brazilian AML/CTF regulations
Familiarity with international regulatory standards, including BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, and OFAC
Ability to evaluate complex customer structures, identify risks, and make sound compliance decisions.
Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex regulatory concepts clearly.
Fluent in Spanish (English is a strong plus).
Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-growing environment with evolving regulatory landscapes.

title: Digital marketing ad strategist em santos (PI)
description:
The Digital Marketing Ad Strategist is a responsible for the performance, health, and scalability of paid advertising accounts across Google Ads, Meta (Facebook & Instagram), and Linked In Ads. This role is heavily focused on account audits, ongoing optimization, technical troubleshooting, and performance improvements.
You will analyze existing ad accounts, identify inefficiencies and technical issues, recommend and implement fixes, and ensure tracking, structure, and strategy are aligned with business objectives.
Requirements
In-depth knowledge of the following platforms: Google ads, Facebook Ads, Microsoft Ads
Detail oriented
Key Responsibilities
Account Audits & Diagnostics
 • Conduct in-depth audits of Google Ads, Meta, Microsoft, and Linked In Ads accounts. Experience or working knowledge across secondary platforms, including Tik Tok, Pinterest, Reddit, X, Snapchat, Spotify, and Amazon.
 • Identify structural issues, wasted spend, tracking gaps, and performance blockers
 • Diagnose bugs and technical issues such as:
 • Incorrect or missing conversion tracking
 • Pixel or tag misfires
 • Attribution and reporting discrepancies
 • Budget pacing and delivery issues
 • Audience overlap and campaign cannibalization
 • Document findings and deliver clear, prioritized optimization recommendations
 Optimization & Performance Management
  • Continuous proactive optimization of campaigns, ad groups, keywords, audiences, bids, and creatives
 • Improve key performance metrics such as CPA, ROAS, CTR, and conversion rate
 • Manage and reallocate budgets based on performance and growth opportunities
 • Plan and execute A/B tests across targeting, creative, offers, and landing pages
 • Optimize accounts across full-funnel stages (awareness, consideration, conversion)
 Strategy & Execution
 • Translate business goals into effective paid media strategies
 • Ensure account structures align with funnel intent and buyer journeys
 • Align ad messaging with audience intent and platform best practices
 Tracking, Data & Reporting
 • Ensure accurate setup and ongoing validation of conversion tracking
 • Work with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and platform analytics to confirm data integrity
 • Analyze performance data to uncover insights, issues, and opportunities
 • Create performance reports that clearly explain results, risks, and next steps
 Process & Quality Control
  • Maintain clean account structure, naming conventions, and documentation
 • Build and follow optimization and audit checklists
 • Stay current on platform updates, policy changes, and best practices
 • Proactively flag risks, inefficiencies, or declining performance trends
Additional Tasks
 • Forecasts and initial ad spend recommendations to assist with the Sales team.
 • Have basic design knowledge and be able to coordinate ad copy and creative with internal team members.
Language Requirements
 • Fluent in English and Portuguese
Salary
$3000 BRL (Brazilian Real) / Per Month to start
Benefits after 6 months
Hiring Process:
Initial Interview with small knowledge test
Second interview with Ads team
Possible follow up questions / test
Final meet and greet meeting

title: Senior business analyst - supply chain em natal (RN)
description:
Who We Are
We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.
Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.
Who We Are Looking For
We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).
This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.
If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.
Key Responsibilities
Business Requirements & Client Engagement
• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.
• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.
• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.
• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.
• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.
Solution Design, Implementation & Testing
• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).
• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.
• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.
• Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.
• Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.
• Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.
• Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.
• Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.
Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)
• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.
• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.
• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.
Must Have
• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).
• Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.
• Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).
• Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.
• Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
• Experience with project management and collaboration tools.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.
• Availability to travel.
• Legally authorized to work in Brazil.
What We Offer
• Competitive salary and benefits package.
• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.
• A collaborative and international work environment.
• Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.
Why Hoist?
If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.
Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.
